notes: Everything is on the 24-hour clock now. Load-in, call times, deadlines and the overrun email were written out as 12-hour while set times were left as you typed them, so one confirmation could say load-in at 4pm and sets at 19:00. One clock everywhere, on the emails, the prep sheet and the checks. A crew rate of zero is a real answer, meaning included in the fee: it no longer counts as a missing rate, and the line reads Included next to the name on the quote and the confirmation rather than nothing or a zero. A line marked This is me does not ask for a rate at all, because it is not a booking. A genuinely blank rate on someone you are booking is still an error, and now says that zero is allowed if they are covered by the fee.
